sections.Profile:
The "Derby" pinball machine, produced by Italian manufacturer A.M.I. in 1975, features a horse racing theme. This electro-mechanical game includes two flippers, three pop bumpers, two slingshots, five standup targets, and two star rollovers. Notably, it has an up-post between the flippers and a wedge head design.

- Manufacturer: A.M.I.
- Years made: 1975
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Wedgehead, Sports, Horses, Original Theme, Horse Racing, 1970s, Single level playfield
